# cubepath_kubernetes_kubeconfig (Data Source)

Fetches the kubeconfig for a Kubernetes cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) UUID of the Kubernetes cluster.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.
- `kubeconfig` (String, Sensitive) The kubeconfig YAML content for connecting to the cluster.
